legal.privacyBody:
## 1. Introduction

This draft explains Epsilon's current client processing and the production practices that still require verification. Epsilon links eligible purchases, purchased-dish feedback and server-confirmed rewards. This is not a lawyer-approved or final privacy policy.

## 2. Information processed

Account data may include name, phone, email supplied by an identity provider/backend, birth date, language, account/authentication identifiers and session credentials. Verification codes are processed transiently, not persisted by the app. Purchase references, dishes, ratings, comments, rewards, wallet history and limited technical data support the service. The camera scans QR references without intentionally recording/uploading photos or video. This client requests no location, contacts, microphone or advertising-tracking permission.

## 3. Google authentication

When enabled and configured, Google sign-in uses openid, email and profile scopes. The backend must verify the identity token and provider identity. Epsilon does not request Gmail, Drive or contacts access through this flow, and matching email alone is not authority to link accounts. Production OAuth verification remains pending.

## 4. Purchases and receipts

Purchase references and server-returned transaction details identify eligible purchases and purchased dishes, enable verified feedback, support reward eligibility and prevent duplicate claims. A reference links to server records; this draft does not assume a QR itself contains personal data. Scanning alone does not authorize a reward.

## 5. Feedback information

Ratings, reasons and comments are account-linked in this app. Participating businesses may receive relevant individual feedback and aggregated insights. The backend handoff requires omitting name/phone from restaurant feedback views; actual dashboard access and redaction must be verified. This draft promises no anonymity. Future accountless feedback is a separate architecture.

## 6. Purposes

Information supports authentication, profile setup, purchase verification, feedback delivery, server-side reward administration, the universal wallet, security, abuse prevention, troubleshooting and business analytics. This draft does not introduce advertising or unrelated profiling purposes.

## 7. Sharing and service providers

Relevant business feedback may be shared as described above. Conditional integrations include Google sign-in, Expo/push infrastructure and consent-based Sentry error reporting. Hosting, SMS/POS providers, their roles and access arrangements require confirmation; this draft names no unconfirmed processor. Any legally required disclosure needs an appropriate basis and review.

## 8. Wallet information

Confirmed/pending balances and reward transaction history support balance display, eligibility administration, duplicate prevention and reward history. Values and eligibility are server-authoritative. The app may retain bounded account-scoped wallet display snapshots; these cannot authorize financial actions. The wallet is not described as a bank account.

## 9. Retention

Information should be retained only as necessary for legitimate operational/legal purposes under an approved retention policy. Server schedules, ledger/fraud exceptions, backup expiry and provider deletion remain unresolved. No fixed retention duration or immediate complete erasure is promised by this draft.

## 10. Security and local storage

Native session credentials use SecureStore; production API transport requires HTTPS. Known account caches and feedback retries use app-local storage and are cleared on logout/deletion. Application-level encryption of those caches is not claimed. Optional crash reporting is off by default and requires consent/configuration. Safeguards reduce risk but cannot guarantee complete security; backend/vendor controls require verification.

## 11. Choices and rights

The app offers profile correction, language settings, notification choices and optional crash-report consent. OS permission controls also apply. Consent withdrawal stops further optional reporting, not an already permitted in-flight request. Production access/correction/privacy request procedures and verified contacts must be completed; this draft invents no legal response deadline.

## 12. Account deletion

Privacy settings send a backend account-deletion request after reauthentication and confirmation. Only success triggers local deletion cleanup. Actual production erasure, retained ledger/audit records, backups and provider handling need verification. Logout does not delete server data. A verified external deletion-request process remains a release requirement.

## 13. Children and eligibility

Current onboarding includes a configurable age gate and birth-date field. Exact age eligibility, treatment of minors and any parental-consent requirements need legal confirmation before release. The technical configuration alone is not legal approval.

## 14. International processing

This draft makes no unsupported promise about server or provider storage countries. Infrastructure locations, cross-border data flows and required safeguards must be documented and reviewed before production release.

## 15. Policy changes

The policy may be updated. Document version and last-updated date identify this bundled draft, not an approved effective policy. Material changes and any necessary notices or acceptance evidence must use an approved process; no client-only consent evidence is fabricated.

## 16. Contact

Use only verified Epsilon privacy/support channels. Approved operator and production contact details are unresolved release inputs; this draft supplies no invented email, address or registration details. Never disclose verification codes, session credentials or complete purchase claims to an unverified contact.

legal.termsBody:
## 1. About Epsilon

Epsilon connects eligible purchases with feedback about purchased dishes or products and, where applicable, server-approved cashback. Features and availability may vary by participating business. This draft does not claim any unconfirmed restaurant partnership.

## 2. Acceptance of Terms

Creating an account or using Epsilon means accepting the applicable Terms of Use and acknowledging the Privacy Policy. Do not use the service if you disagree. These documents are drafts for legal review; final publication and any required consent process remain separate.

## 3. Eligibility

Current onboarding applies a configured minimum-age check and asks for a birth date. This technical check does not establish legal eligibility. Age, minors' consent and any geographic restrictions must be confirmed before public release.

## 4. Your account

Provide accurate information and keep control of your authentication methods. Do not share accounts, impersonate others or disclose verification codes. Report suspicious access through verified support channels. Security restrictions must follow applicable rules and proportionate review procedures.

## 5. Purchase verification

Some features require an eligible transaction, such as a receipt-specific QR or purchase reference. Scanning does not guarantee a reward. The backend checks eligibility and may reject expired, invalid, used or ineligible references. Do not fabricate or manipulate transactions.

## 6. Feedback and ratings

Rate dishes or products you actually purchased. Do not submit unlawful, abusive, intentionally false, infringing, harassing or spam content. Feedback is account-linked and may support business feedback views or analytics as described in the Privacy Policy; anonymity is not promised.

## 7. Cashback and rewards

Rewards depend on eligible transactions/actions and server-side approval, limits and program rules shown in the app. Invalid, duplicated, refunded or fraudulent transactions may lead to refusal or reversal under approved rules. Pending amounts are not guaranteed money. Expiry, redemption, withdrawal and transfer rights are not finalized by this draft.

## 8. Universal Epsilon wallet

The wallet displays one Epsilon reward balance and related history, based on server records. It is not described here as a bank account, deposit, investment or payment institution. No cash-withdrawal entitlement is promised. Financial characterization and reward conditions require business and legal review.

## 9. Prohibited use

Do not steal or reuse purchase claims, fabricate purchases, manipulate rewards, create accounts for abuse, impersonate people, interfere with systems or attempt unauthorized access. Do not automate reward exploitation or harass participating businesses or users.

## 10. Participating businesses

Businesses are separate entities. Their dishes, products, prices, hours and service availability may be controlled by them. Epsilon's role and each party's responsibilities must be accurately disclosed. This draft does not waive rights that cannot lawfully be waived.

## 11. Availability and changes

Features may change and temporary interruptions may occur. Network or service failures can delay purchase verification, feedback delivery or wallet updates. Authoritative server records determine outcomes; the app does not promise uninterrupted access or guaranteed reward processing times.

## 12. Restrictions and termination

Fraud, abuse, security risks or serious/repeated terms violations may justify proportionate account restrictions. Applicable rules, review and appeal processes must be finalized before release. This draft does not grant arbitrary unlimited suspension powers or automatic reward forfeiture.

## 13. Intellectual property

Epsilon software, branding, logo, design and original materials are subject to applicable intellectual-property rights. Business materials remain subject to their owners' rights. User content requires only permissions appropriate to operate the service; this draft invents no ownership transfer or perpetual blanket licence.

## 14. Disclaimers and responsibility

This draft does not purport to exclude mandatory consumer rights or non-excludable responsibility. Service obligations, remedies and any permitted liability limits require legal review. Purchase eligibility and rewards are not guaranteed merely by scanning or submitting feedback.

## 15. Account deletion

Profile privacy settings provide a backend deletion request with reauthentication and deliberate confirmation. Production erasure and retention exceptions remain unverified. Logout ends local account access; it does not delete the account. Some records may require legitimate retention, but no duration or instant-erasure promise is invented here.

## 16. Changes to these Terms

Terms may be updated. Material changes should be communicated appropriately where required. Applicable versions, publication dates and any necessary acceptance evidence must be managed through the approved service process; this app does not fabricate consent records.

## 17. Governing law and disputes

Epsilon is being developed from Azerbaijan. The governing-law and dispute provisions require legal review before public release. This draft selects no court, arbitration procedure or unsupported jurisdiction-specific waiver.

## 18. Contact

Only verified Epsilon support/legal channels should be used. Operator identity and approved production contacts are unresolved release inputs; configuration-example emails and addresses are not presented as verified contacts. Never send verification codes, credentials or complete purchase tokens through unverified channels.

1.question: How do I scan a receipt?
1.answer: Tap Scan and place the receipt QR code inside the frame. Purchased dishes appear after the server checks the code.

2.question: Why is a receipt unsupported?
2.answer: The restaurant must be integrated with Epsilon. If the code cannot be read, try entering it manually or contact support.

3.question: When is cashback confirmed?
3.answer: The server determines cashback eligibility, amount and status. Pending and confirmed amounts are shown separately in your wallet.

4.question: How do I delete my account?
4.answer: Choose Delete account under Privacy and security. Verify your identity again and complete the confirmation shown.
